title: The Month BitPesa Lost M-Pesa and Leaned Towards Business Payments
conflicts: Rossiello's 2024 op-ed says an unnamed telco ended BitPesa's contract and dates it to 2014; reporting dates the Safaricom cut-off to 12 November 2015. The story uses the reported date and does not tie her 'coffee' remark to Safaricom. Volume claims differ ($1 billion moved by 2019 per Ventureburn; '$9 billion' per Rossiello in 2024) and are not used. The two sides' claims in the Safaricom case are attributed, not judged.
notes: Episode dated 2015-11 rather than the slate's 2016, because the documented turning point is the M-Pesa cut-off of November-December 2015, with Rossiello's own explanation of the business pivot recorded in June 2016 (Unchained podcast transcript). The story is explicit that the shift was already under way before the cut-off. The 2023 lawsuit with a bank is not mentioned.
